description: Trois poses indépendantes du garde royal existant : posture prête, anticipation et estoc. Adaptation de gameplay, sans identité canonique supplémentaire.

assets.name: Garde royal · posture de combat
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent full-body transparent game sprite for Yautja: The Long Hunt, a royal-court combat encounter. Image 1 is a character identity and material REFERENCE, not scenery. Preserve the exact same single Predator/Yautja royal guard identity: bronze angular biomask with narrow amber eyes, long black dreadlocks with bronze rings, mottled olive skin, black body net, layered aged bronze angular chest/shoulder/leg armor, clawed bare feet and the same long double-ended bladed spear/combistick. This character is a gameplay adaptation, not a newly claimed canon character. Preserve body proportions, costume and weapon geometry, restrained warm upper-left lighting and detailed cinematic game illustration. CAMERA: near-orthographic side-on three-quarter view at standing character height, facing LEFT, consistent usable side-scrolling perspective. Full character and FULL weapon entirely inside the image, including all dreadlock tips, toes and spear points, at least 8% true transparent margin all around. Readable silhouette at 220px display height. No second character, no costume variants, no panels, no atlas, no labels, no writing, no HUD, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no atmosphere or glowing background. Actual transparent background everywhere outside the subject, not black or brown background and not painted checkerboard. Keep precise hard silhouette and genuine alpha. ONE pose only. POSE: poised defensive ready stance. Feet planted apart with both heels/toes visible on a consistent horizontal baseline, knees slightly flexed, torso slightly turned toward the viewer but head looking LEFT. Both hands hold the spear diagonally across the torso, foremost blade toward upper LEFT, rear blade toward lower RIGHT, at safe distance from all frame edges. The weight is balanced, ready to react. Distinct combat pose, not the vertical ceremonial stance from the reference. Square or landscape canvas with enough space for the entire diagonal weapon.
assets.pivotConvention: source bounds unchanged; feet anchored by measured alpha16 silhouette; new combat poses are separate files, not an atlas
assets.edgeReview: full visible silhouette; zero alpha128 pixels on image edges
assets.scaleConvention: Shared 1027px standing reference across all three poses; overhead reach and crouch keep their authored extent.
